title: Webhook
description: Sends the event as a JSON POST to any HTTP(S) endpoint, optionally HMAC-signed.

url.title: URL
url.description: Endpoint CertForge sends the event to. Kept secret: a token embedded in the URL should not be exposed once saved.

authHeader.title: Authorization header
authHeader.description: Sent verbatim as the request's Authorization header, for example "Bearer <token>".

headers.title: Extra headers
headers.description: Additional headers sent with every request. A credential-looking name (Authorization, Cookie, or one containing token, key, secret or auth) is rejected; use authHeader for a credential instead.

signingSecret.title: Signing secret
signingSecret.description: HMAC-SHA256 key for the X-CertForge-Signature header. Leave empty to send the request unsigned.

caPem.title: CA certificate (PEM)
caPem.description: Additional trusted root certificate(s) for this endpoint, PEM-encoded.
